text:
You're accepting disrespect as proof of love.

You learned young: asserting yourself costs. A parent's anger was the price. So you learned to ignore limits. Your own, and hers.

Now you absorb betrayal and call it loyalty. Every time a woman stays through your silence, you feel loved.

But you're not being loved. You're auditioning for approval by making yourself small.

This is a trauma loop. And you can end it today.

Stop. Set a limit. Keep it.
caption: Men confuse discipline with self erasure. Real success habits start when you set your first boundary. Send this to a man who needs it today. #discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #datingpsychology #successhabits
